message: No detected input validation: The code loads CSV files and passes data directly into processing without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards; exploratory analysis logs statistics but does not enforce or validate them.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded only from local file paths (e.g., 'data/listings.csv') with no remote source fetching, so no checksum, authentication, or integrity verification is applicable or present.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no validation of label distributions, expected label sets, or use of any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab anywhere in the pipeline code.
No detected model integrity verification: The code uses pickle.load to deserialize models/data via load_serialized() with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before loading.
No detected label distribution validation: The code performs exploratory checks (null values, zeros, unique values) but never validates label distribution or class balance before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, trigger detection, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used in this code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or any custom adversarial stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation in the evaluation stage.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path loads serialized models and preprocessed data without any input shape, range, or schema validation before passing data to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is present that checks model predictions for NaN values, out-of-range results, or other sanity bounds before returning outputs.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses a GradientBoostingRegressor/SVR-based numeric regression model, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
